notes: P4e22e070e6 G4: 'That player shuffles, then creates a 2/2 black Zombie creature token': the TARGET OPPONENT creates (and controls) the Zombie. Massacre Wurm then enters under you: creatures your opponents control get -2/-2, so the opponent's 2/2 Zombie dies and that player loses 2 life (Wurm's second ability). Were the Zombie yours, it would survive and nobody would lose life.
